claims.statement: Semantic satiation describes temporary subjective loss of a familiar word's apparent meaning after repetition.
claims.limit: Editorial background, not universal effect.

claims.statement: Prime repeated thirty times vs three yielded reduced N400 at centrofrontal electrodes in 2017 study.
claims.limit: Not a direct measure of proprietary meditation effects.

claims.statement: Conceptual-task deterioration can occur without identical stimulus repetition.
claims.limit: Different task; not proof of one shared mechanism.

claims.statement: Every person will lose meaning after exactly thirty repetitions.
claims.limit: Magnitude/experience vary by task and participant.

claims.statement: Semantic satiation proves audio reprograms belief, health or cognitive performance.
claims.limit: Category error between semantic priming and branded efficacy.

claims.statement: Historical Puységur records describe magnetic somnambulism, witness and consent issues.
claims.limit: Historical testimony is not clinical or causal validation.

claims.statement: Inspire3 currently lists Zen12, Hypnosis Live and Brainwave Shots.
claims.limit: Do not infer endorsement or publisher permission.

claims.statement: Zen12 Premium seller describes 12 levels x four audio styles = 48 MP3s.
claims.limit: Package contents not personally purchased/tested by FV.

claims.statement: Zen12 seller claims auditory pulses induce profound meditation and cognitive/health benefits.
claims.limit: No product-specific independent substantiation in reviewed sources.

claims.statement: Zen12 official standard page displays Premium $87.99 while separate promo displays $37 coupon.
claims.limit: Different paths/conditions; no numeric sales-page price in presell CTA.

claims.statement: Standard Zen12 page advertises one-year money-back guarantee.
claims.limit: Eligibility/refund performance independent verification outstanding.

claims.statement: Promotional countdown, coupon or "over 3000 studies" are independently verified.
claims.limit: Do not repeat urgency/scientific aggregate as proof.

claims.statement: Public Inspire3 portal shows a general affiliate program and generic commission language.
claims.limit: Never impute a payout, personal acceptance or exact fee to FV.

claims.statement: Final Vestige has accepted Inspire3 publisher terms and has an issued tracking link.
claims.limit: Public portal and promotional Gmail are insufficient.

claims.statement: Publisher's promotional emails authorize newsletter promotion.
claims.limit: Requires account-specific channel permission, separate from consumer marketing.

claims.statement: Hypnosis Live Total Focus seller page describes one 33-minute, 47MB download.
claims.limit: Its reported performance improvements are seller claims.

claims.statement: Hypnosis Live Total Focus standard listing shows $24.44 with $29.95 crossed out and 14-day refund description.
claims.limit: Do not state final checkout or guaranteed return outcome.

claims.statement: Brainwave Shots seller markets a range of 15-minute themed tracks.
claims.limit: No product-specific efficacy proof verified.

claims.statement: An affiliate link near a recommendation requires plain-language material-connection disclosure.
claims.limit: Don't rely on the global disclosure page alone.

claims.statement: Health-product efficacy claims require adequate competent and reliable evidence.
claims.limit: Avoid unsupported implied as well as explicit claims.

claims.statement: FV existing Focus Fieldbook is a free 52-page routine with existing Jetpack/Dispatch route.
claims.limit: No new form, list or welcome message.

claims.statement: R268 optional 42s film is an actual hosted playable video.
claims.limit: Poster and transcript only; separate R257 local film does not make R268 preview playable.

claims.statement: A free timer can provide a twelve-minute pause without an audio purchase.
claims.limit: Not a controlled clinical alternative, no treatment claim.

claims.statement: Affiliate outbound click equals verified sale or commission.
claims.limit: Reconcile merchant-reported settled transactions, refunds and fees separately.

claims.statement: A FV-owned paid Mind SKU is fully sellable, rights-cleared and fulfillment-verified.
claims.limit: Fallback cannot be activated from Payhip assumptions.

claims.statement: The new Mind Archive preview is live on WordPress.
claims.limit: Source-controlled HTML only.
